symptoms: Dark brown to black lesions may appear on older leaves.
Lesions can develop characteristic concentric ring patterns.
Yellowing may develop around affected areas.
Severe infection can cause premature leaf loss.
general_management: Remove heavily affected plant material where practical.
Maintain good field sanitation.
Improve air circulation around plants.
Avoid prolonged leaf wetness and unnecessary overhead irrigation.
Monitor nearby plants for progression.
Potato___Early_blight.advisory: Use the prediction as a screening aid and confirm severe or uncertain cases with an agricultural expert.

Improve field monitoring during cool and humid weather.
Maintain good sanitation.
Seek local agricultural guidance for disease-management decisions.
